headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when Christian Cage vs. Darby Allin fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title in a 2 out of 3 Falls match, appearing on WrestleDream, rated 8.92 ? a match fans still talk about. In the main event, Cage retained the TNT Title over Allin after Allin's own prot?g? Nick Wayne turned on him ? a betrayal immediately followed by the shocking arrival of a debuting Adam Copeland, who speared Luchasaurus to save Sting and Allin.
It was 2025 when Young Bucks & Alexander touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.69 ? a strong outing.

2021 brought us this moment: it marked the first-ever meeting between Bryan Danielson and Nick Jackson, getting things started right out of the gate on Rampage, rated 7.79 ? a good, competitive contest.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: Kris Statlander vs. Julia Hart clashed for the AEW TBS Title, appearing on WrestleDream, rated 6.65. Julia Hart was challenging for gold for the very first time. It marked Kris Statlander's 10th match with the title on the line. Julia Hart pushed Statlander to her limit in her pay-per-view singles debut, but multiple tombstone piledrivers were enough for the champion to retain the TBS Title.

Rewind to 2025, when Darby Allin reached proof of just how much mileage they've put in: their 150th match in AEW, teaming with Kris Statlander to face Marina Shafir and Wheeler Yuta in a Tornado Tag match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 7.45 — a good, competitive contest.
